title: Philip
summary: Raleigh names Philip in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Philip King of France, named with Richard King of England at Ptolomais. Not the Philip already on the record. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter VII, §. III, subsection IV, sig. 221b–222a
